fruit-destroy.name: Fruit Destroy
fruit-destroy.card: Match pairs of fruit, chain combos and shoo the hungry critters.
fruit-destroy.zenCard: Calm pair matching with no clock, no score and no mistakes.
fruit-destroy.quickCard: One fast minute of matching. Beat your own best score.
fruit-destroy.about: Fruit Destroy is a fast fruit-matching arcade game. Find two of the same fruit, toss them into the basket and chain combos before the critters grab a bite.
Play Classic levels with up to three stars each, survive the flood in Endless, try the Daily board that is the same for everyone, go for a one-minute Quick game, or slow right down in Zen.
fruit-destroy.steps: Tap a fruit, then tap its twin. Matched pairs fly off the board.
Match again within 3 seconds to build a combo: ×1.2, ×1.5, ×2, up to ×3.
From level 3, hungry critters sneak in. Tap them before they take a bite for +50 points.
fruit-destroy.note: Click on a computer or tap on a phone. Keyboard: Tab moves between fruit, Enter or Space selects, Esc pauses.
fruit-destroy.crittersSub: Each critter goes for its favourite food. If it reaches the fruit, that pair is lost and a new one appears.
fruit-destroy.faq: Yes. Every mode is free to play in your browser, with no download and no sign-up.
Yes. It runs in any modern browser on phones, tablets and computers, in portrait or landscape.
Yes. There is no violence and no chat, and the rules are simple: find two of the same fruit.

bubble-pop.name: Bubble Pop
bubble-pop.card: Pop drifting bubbles with a tap or a swipe. No timer, no losing.
bubble-pop.about: Bubble Pop is a small, satisfying toy: the screen fills with soft fruit-coloured bubbles and you pop them however you like. Tap one at a time or drag your finger through a whole cluster.
There is no timer and no way to lose. When the screen is empty, fill it again.
bubble-pop.steps: Press Start to fill the screen with bubbles.
Tap, click or swipe through bubbles to pop them. On a computer, Space pops the bubble nearest the centre.
Pop them all, then press Refill for a fresh screen.
bubble-pop.stageLabel: Bubble field. Press Space to pop the bubble nearest the centre.
bubble-pop.kbd: Keyboard: focus the bubble field and press Space to pop.
bubble-pop.startSub: Tap or swipe through the bubbles.
bubble-pop.doneSub: That was {n} bubbles. Want another screen?
breathe.name: Breathe with Fruit
breathe.card: Follow a growing and shrinking orange slice for a slow, quiet pause.
breathe.about: A short visual pause. The orange slice grows while you breathe in and shrinks while you breathe out. Pick a pace that feels comfortable and a length that fits your break.
There are no breath holds. You can pause or stop at any moment.
breathe.steps: Choose a pace and how long you want to go.
Breathe in as the slice grows, breathe out as it shrinks.
Pause or stop whenever you like.
breathe.note: This is a relaxation exercise, not a medical treatment.
breathe.safety: Breathe at a pace that feels easy. If you feel dizzy or uncomfortable, stop and breathe normally.

sand-art.card: Pour coloured sand and watch it pile up into layers. Draw with a finger or mouse.
sand-art.about: Pour fruit-coloured sand onto the canvas and watch it fall, slide and settle into layers, like a sand bottle. Mix colours, change the pour size and make something nobody else will have.
Your picture is kept in this browser, so you can come back to it later.
sand-art.steps: Pick a colour or the mixed palette.
Press and drag on the canvas to pour sand.
Clear the canvas to start over, or save your picture.

fruit-maze.name: Fruit Maze
fruit-maze.card: Guide the boy through an orchard maze, collect every fruit and dodge the animals. 20 levels, with seeds to throw from level 11.
fruit-maze.about: Fruit Maze is an arcade maze seen from above. You guide a boy along the garden paths, pick up every fruit on the map and keep away from the animals.

Apples are worth 10 points, bananas 15, oranges 20 and strawberries 25, plus 100 for clearing the level. You have three lives. Bumping into an animal costs one life and sends you back to the garden gate, where animals never go, with two seconds of safety. There are 20 levels. The first ten grow from a small 11×11 garden with a single turtle to a 19×19 orchard with ten animals. From level 11 the boy can throw seeds: press Space (or the 🌰 button) to stun an animal for a few seconds. After that every level turns the difficulty up: bigger mazes up to 23×23, more and faster animals, fewer seeds and shorter stuns.

The turtle walks back and forth along one path. The fox patrols by always turning right when it can. The monkey is quicker and takes the next turn in a fixed order at every crossing, so you can learn their routes. The hedgehog, from level 13, follows you when you come within a few steps.
fruit-maze.steps: Move with the arrow keys or W A S D. On a phone, hold the arrow buttons or swipe on the board.
Walk over fruit to collect it. The counter at the top shows how many are left.
From level 11, press Space, the 🌰 button or tap the board to throw a seed the way the boy is facing.
Collect every fruit to finish the level. Press Esc or the pause button to take a break.
